purpose: zistit ci pohyb nesie sirsi market participation alebo je izolovany fake impulse
mechanism_value: moze filtrovat slabe setupy a zlepsit toxic-subset detekciu
mechanical_hypothesis: A move confirmed by broad and internally coherent participation should be more trustworthy than an isolated impulse whose leader-follower structure and cluster agreement are fractured.
stack_cohesion_rule: All derived features must answer the same question: whether the apparent move is supported by wider market participation rather than being an isolated print.
